mapper.select:
SELECT r.RSV_NO, r.RSV_DATE, r.END_DATE, r.REQUEST, r.RSV_STATUS,
s.STORE_NAME,
m.MENU_NAME, m.MENU_PRICE, m.M_STATUS,
u.USER_NAME, u.PHONE
FROM reservation r INNER JOIN store s ON r.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO INNER JOIN store_menu m ON r.MENU_NO = m.MENU_NO INNER JOIN users u ON r.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE r.RSV_NO = 11
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_master ( USER_ID, RSV_NO, ORD_NAME, TOTALPRICE, TID, PAY_TYPE, METHOD_NO, PAY_STATUS, PAY_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{rsvNo}, #{ordName}, #{totalPrice}, #{tid}, #{payType}, NULL, 'PAID', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET RSV_STATUS = '결제완료' WHERE RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
